adjudication.rationale: In spec/controllers/embed_controller_spec.rb there is no `render_views`, so controller specs won’t compile or execute the new templates (app/views/embed/best.html.erb, loading.html.erb, layouts/embed.html.erb). Additionally, in the “creates a topic view when a topic_id is found” example, `TopicView.expects(:new).with(...)` does not specify a return value, so under Mocha it will return nil by default, making `@topic_view` nil; if views were rendered, best.html.erb would likely error when calling `@topic_view.posts`. This is a real, diff-grounded testing gap, not a runtime defect by itself.
